title.zh: Zcash holders overwhelmingly back faster transactions and bitcoin-style halvings
title.en: Zcash holders overwhelmingly back faster transactions and bitcoin-style halvings

current_state.zh: Zcash holders approved NU7 governance measures with overwhelming majorities, including 25-second block times, preserving the bitcoin-style halving schedule, delaying Network Sustainability Mechanism fee reissuance until 2031, and disabling obsolete Sprout transactions.
